dependency_notes: All test-code stories (S1–S5) edit the single new file e2e/tests/multi-user-3p.property.spec.ts sequentially — there is no parallel-implementation race, so no frozen seam contract is needed; the dependency is enforced by story_order. S1 establishes ModelState3P/RealSystem3P/beforeAll-afterAll (the in-file shapes every later story builds on). S2 (per-actor task commands) and S3 (group-lifecycle commands) both depend on S1 and are independent of each other. S4 (headline assertions) depends on S1 and on the two-party.ts test-hook readers (present → strict form). S5 (wire the property test) depends on S2+S3+S4. S6 (coverage-matrix doc edit) is independent of the test code and is a pure markdown edit (lighter_path). S7 (wall-clock validation) depends on S5 being runnable and is execution-bound (runs `make e2e` three times).
mock_resolution_plan: No mocks introduced. This is a test-only epic consuming existing fixtures and real browser contexts.

stories.name: per-actor-task-commands
stories.title: Per-actor task command classes (Ct, Ut, Sc, As, Un, Dt, Rl)
stories.description: Port the 2-party task commands to 3-party form, each parameterised on actor: "A" | "B" | "C". CtCommand3P(actor,title,desc), UtCommand3P(actor,title), ScCommand3P(actor,status), AsCommand3P(actor), UnCommand3P(actor), DtCommand3P(actor), RlCommand3P(actor). Each check(m) gates on m.actorIsMember(actor) && m.groupId !== null (As/Un/Dt/Ut/Sc also require m.tasks.size>0; As requires a pubkey). Each run dispatches the task event via the actor's page and asserts its postcondition (A2/A4/A5/A11) via r.getTask(actor, ...). Every toString() returns `${actor}.Verb(args)` matching the matrix DSL.
stories.notes: Depends on S1's ModelState3P/RealSystem3P shapes. Independent of S3.

stories.name: group-lifecycle-commands
stories.title: Group-lifecycle command classes (Cg, In, Lg, Fd, Rd, Sw)
stories.description: Port the group-lifecycle commands to 3-party form. CgCommand3P (admin-only: dispatches on pageA; check true only when m.groupId===null && !m.memberA). InCommand3P(invitee: "B"|"C") (inviter always A; check true only when m.memberA && !m.actorIsMember(invitee); no-op shape pruned by check, not silently no-op'd at run). LgCommand3P(actor) (each actor leaves via own page). FdCommand3P(actor) (A forgets a B-or-C leaf; check true only when m.memberA && (m.memberB||m.memberC) && m.groupId!==null). RdCommand3P(actor,name) (per-actor own device). SwCommand3P (switches pageA between bunker A and bunker B ONLY — A↔C and B↔C are NOT generated; document inline naming AC-3P-SW-1). Admin-only/MIP-03 constraints are model preconditions, not runtime checks.
stories.notes: Depends on S1. Independent of S2. SwCommand3P restricted to A↔B (Design Decision #6).

stories.name: headline-assertions-3p
stories.title: Headline invariant assertions (assertC0_3P, S5, S6, S7, S10)
stories.description: Implement the three-actor headline assertions. assertC0_3P (guard: groupId!==null && memberA && memberB && memberC) asserts task-id sets pairwise equal across A/B/C, per-task status/assignee/title equal, member sets equal (getGroupMembersHook), epoch equal (getGroupEpochHook), per-pubkey leafCount equal (getPubkeyLeafCountHook) for every p in unionMembers. assertS5_3P runs the biconditional member<=>leafCount>=1 for pubkeyA/B/C scoped to m.groupId. assertS6_3P walks epochSequenceA/B/C non-decreasing. assertS7_3P triggers when lastSwitched!==null and asserts post-switch context holds no prior-identity groups. assertS10_3P asserts device-row count equals getPubkeyLeafCountHook for each actor's own pubkey. STRICT FORM is live (hooks present); include the documented degraded-form fallbacks + a top-of-assertion comment naming AC-3P-DEG-2 / the l3-completion hook story.
stories.notes: Depends on S1. Consumes getGroupEpochHook/getGroupMembersHook/getPubkeyLeafCountHook from two-party.ts (read-only import; do not modify two-party.ts).

stories.name: wall-clock-validation
stories.title: Wall-clock validation + whole-epic scope/no-regression checks
stories.description: Execution-bound story. Run `make e2e` against the new 3P file three times locally; record the maximum observed wall-clock in the epic completion notes (AC-3P-WC-1). If any run exceeds 720s, reduce numRuns to 12 (or maxCommands to 8) and repeat, capturing the chosen value in a code comment beside the numRuns literal (AC-3P-WC-2); note the CI envelope expectation (AC-3P-WC-3). Also perform the whole-epic guardrail checks: no src/ change (AC-X-NO-PROD-CHANGE-3P-1), 2-party file untouched (AC-X-NO-2P-CHANGE-1), three-party.spec.ts not deleted/renamed/skipped (AC-X-NO-EXAMPLE-DELETION-3P-1), make test unaffected + make e2e runs the 3P file (AC-X-CI-3P-1). AC-VAL-3P-1 is a one-shot MANUAL fault-injection recorded in completion notes — not an automated assertion. Treat persistent multi-context red as harness flakiness per project memory unless a real 3-party divergence is shown.
stories.notes: Depends on S5 being runnable. Execution-bound: runs the heavy multi-context e2e suite (12-min envelope) up to 3 times; sensitive to documented multi-context e2e flakiness.
